phrases.say: Vehicle not released at the port?
Four things hold up most vehicles.
The steamship line hasn't been paid.
The port's roll-on, roll-off charge hasn't been paid.
The original Bill of Lading hasn't been surrendered.
We contact the port, find out which one it is, and tell you exactly what's needed.
